description: Agent Legal: submit a statement of work with the master agreement it sits under: the statement of work with its reference, the master agreement it cites, each party, each item of scope, the currency, the total fees, each fee line with its id, item and amount, and its first and last day; the master agreement with its reference, each party, each service it covers, the currency, the most one statement of work may charge, its effective date and last day, and the longest statement of work it allows in months. The signed report gives the statement of work and the master agreement, the reference cited against the master’s own, each party against the master’s parties, each item of scope against the services the master covers with every item outside them named, the fees against the cap with the total of the fee lines, and the work’s first and last day against the master’s term and the longest statement of work it allows, and counts them, and names a divergent statement of work: another master agreement reference, a party the master does not name, scope outside the master’s scope, another currency, fees above the cap and a term that starts before the master, ends after it or runs longer than it allows; then a stated total unlike its fee lines, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A reference, parties, scope, fees or a start or end the master states and the statement of work leaves out, or a master agreement that states none of these, leaves the statement of work unverified. The reference reads by its letters and digits, parties as parties without a legal suffix, scope by its words with plurals folded, fees to the cent in one currency, and the longest statement of work counts its months to the same calendar day. Verdict legal_sow_divergent, legal_sow_partial, legal_sow_unverified or legal_sow_consistent. POST /api/legal-sow-check. Reads the contract records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never drafts, negotiates, signs or files anything, judges no fairness of terms and no readiness of a deal to settle, and leaves enforceability, interpretation and legal advice to lawyers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Legal reads contract records across the agreement lifecycle for consistency between documents: an executed agreement, a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, an execution record, a renewal or termination notice, the exhibits attached to an agreement and an assignment record, each against the term sheet or deal summary, the master agreement, the pricing terms and the quote, the agreement it amends, the signature requirements, the notice clause, the exhibits the agreement references or the assignment clause it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral and compares different documents with each other, not versions of one document. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-legal-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-legal/.

item.description: What the fee line pays for.

parties.description: Each party the statement of work names.

scope.description: Each service or deliverable in the statement of work’s scope.
